data.title: Bluewaters Residences Building 2
data.about:
Redefine luxury living in the 21st century by indulging in life’s best pleasures only at Bluewaters Residence Building 2. Ideally located off the coast of JBR opposite The Beach, this pioneering urban community is a perfect blend of island & waterfront living with the vibrancy of the city. Additionally, it offers a million reasons to be loved by families with its diverse array of scenic spots and experiences that will make you feel more alive than ever.

The Home of Ain Dubai
Offering a myriad of lifestyle opportunities for both bachelors and families, this world-class destination is home to key landmarks and icons. One of these is Ain Dubai, the largest observation wheel in the world. Hence, Bluewaters is set to become of the grandest tourism hotspots complete with avant-garde residential, hospitality, entertainment, and retail concepts and experiences.

Shop and Dine Like There’s No Tomorrow
At Bluewaters, shopping will become an integral part of your daily life with shops spanning across the boulevard and small scale buildings. The ground and first floor levels feature 132 outlets with an extra 32 units under residential buildings, which accommodate a mix of cafes, restaurants, retail, and entertainment concepts and experiences. If you are a foodie, the waterfront outlets offer ample cuisines from upscale restaurants to cool bistros.

location_tile.title: Bluewaters by Meraas is within short distance to and from Dubai Marina and is just a short drive from Abu Dhabi, making it a highly accessible destination.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Connected to the rest of the city by a direct road link from Sheikh Zayed Road, this community is set to operate the Group Rapid Transit service that provides passengers with a distinct and enjoyable travel experience through a driverless vehicle system.

  • 7 mins to and from Dubai Marina
  • 20 mins to and from Downtown Dubai
  • 30 mins to and from Dubai International Airport & Al Maktoum Airport
  • 45 mins to and from Abu Dhabi Airport
